summary: Sandbach United put on an impressive attacking display against Wolverhampton Casuals, running out 4-1 winners with goals from Max Williams and Matty Birchall (twice), plus a late strike from Kieran Nolan. Nolan was particularly influential after coming on as a substitute in the second half, creating chances and finding the net, while Barry also contributed to the attacking play. The Bach's attacking prowess was on full show as they dominated the latter stages of the match to secure a convincing victory.
